descriptionHtml:
Low profile. Coated wipe-clean top. For the crate floor and the boot.

Derwent is a low-profile dog crate mat with a coated wipe-clean surface, in Large 60 × 45cm, XL 75 × 55cm and XXL 90 × 65cm. It suits a crate base or a car boot.

Look at what is actually on the floor of your crate. It is a plastic tray, and whatever goes on top of it has to survive a dog climbing in with wet feet, turning round twice, and doing the whole thing again at four in the morning. In most houses the answer is a folded towel.

This sits at mat height. No sides and no bolster, so it drops onto a crate tray or a boot floor and stays flat where it lands.

What they get

  • A mat shape, not a bed shape: No deep walls to compress, so a crate door shuts on it and a boot lid does not catch.
  • A coated surface that wipes: A damp cloth and a little mild soap deal with the everyday mess.
  • Three footprints, 60 × 45cm to 90 × 65cm: Enough steps to match a crate tray or a boot floor directly.
  • One familiar surface away from home: The same mat at the vet, at your sister's house and in the back of the car, alongside a proper vehicle restraint.

Best for: crates that live in the kitchen, boot floors, and owners who would far rather wipe something down than run another wash.

Why it is worth the money

The Large is £99, the XL £139 and the XXL £149. What you are buying is the laundry you no longer do. A fabric crate liner is in the machine every fortnight and shabby inside a year. A coated mat is a cloth, a minute, and back in the crate before the kettle has boiled.

And you are not gambling the money. If they have not claimed it within 100 nights, we collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

Two honest trades. It does not go in the machine unless your care label expressly permits it, because a wash cycle is what destroys a coated finish. And it is a mat, so there is not much depth under the hips. If you want crate bedding that machine washes, a quilted crate mattress is the shape to look at.

Size and fit

SizeListed dimensions (cm)What to know
Large60 × 45The smallest footprint
XL75 × 5515cm longer and 10cm wider than the Large
XXL90 × 65The most floor area of the three

Start with the crate tray or the boot floor rather than the dog, then check it against your dog. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one fits.

Everyday care

Wipe with a damp cloth and mild soap, then allow to dry. Do not machine-wash unless the product care label expressly permits it.

A bed is a comfort accessory, not a vehicle restraint. Check crate fit without bunching or blocking access.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.
